template.name: Treasury & Cash
template.description: Bank account governance, bank signatories, cash and bank reconciliations, electronic payments, borrowings and covenants, investments, foreign exchange and hedging, and cash forecasting.

risks.title: Bank accounts are opened, closed or signatories changed without Board or Treasury Committee authorization.
Cash and bank balances in the ledger do not agree to bank records, and unreconciled items conceal errors or misappropriation.
Unauthorized or fraudulent electronic payments are executed (including business email compromise and payment file manipulation).
Borrowings, interest and fees are recorded incompletely or inaccurately, and covenant breaches are not identified, affecting classification and disclosure.
Investments and derivatives are entered into outside approved policy limits or are valued incorrectly (IFRS 9 classification, fair value hierarchy, hedge accounting).
Foreign currency balances are translated at incorrect rates or FX gains/losses are misstated.
Petty cash and cash on hand are misappropriated or unsupported.

controls.title: Bank account and signatory governance
controls.description: Opening or closing bank accounts and changes to authorized signatories require a Board resolution (or Treasury Committee approval under delegated authority) and are executed by the Treasury Manager. Treasury maintains a bank account and mandate register that is confirmed with each bank semi-annually and reviewed by the CFO.

controls.title: Bank reconciliation preparation and review
controls.description: Every bank account is reconciled to the bank statement monthly (main operating and collection accounts daily) by a Treasury Accountant who does not process payments; reconciling items are listed, aged and cleared within 30 days, with unusual items (unidentified receipts, stale cheques, unpresented transfers over 30 days) investigated. Each reconciliation is reviewed and signed by the Financial Controller within 5 working days of month end.

controls.title: Dual authorization and payment limits in bank portals
controls.description: All electronic payments are initiated by Treasury from ERP-generated payment files and released in the bank portal under dual authorization by two approved signatories, with matrix limits (single signatory prohibited; two Category A signatories above SAR 1 million). Bank portal user access and limits are reconciled to the approved signatory matrix quarterly.

controls.title: Payment file integrity and beneficiary verification
controls.description: Payment files are transmitted to the bank via host-to-host or encrypted upload; the bank portal displays file hash/total which is agreed by the releasing signatory to the ERP payment run summary. Any request to change a beneficiary bank account received by email or phone is verified through a call-back to a known contact before actioning; urgent payment requests bypassing the ERP are prohibited.

controls.title: Borrowings register and interest accrual review
controls.description: Treasury maintains a register of all facilities, drawdowns, repayments, interest rates and fees, reconciled monthly to lender statements and to the GL; interest accruals and effective interest rate amortization of transaction costs are calculated and reviewed by the Financial Controller. Loan confirmations are obtained from all lenders at year end.

controls.title: Covenant compliance monitoring
controls.description: Treasury calculates financial covenants (leverage, interest cover, tangible net worth) for each facility quarterly from the closed ledger, compares to the thresholds in the facility agreements, and reports headroom and any breach or forecast breach to the CFO and Audit Committee; breaches are assessed for the impact on current/non-current classification of borrowings.

controls.title: Investment and hedging policy compliance
controls.description: Investments and derivative transactions are executed only with approved counterparties within the limits (instrument type, tenor, concentration, credit rating) of the Board-approved Treasury Policy, on a deal ticket approved by the Treasury Manager and confirmed independently by Finance against counterparty confirmations. Treasury reports policy compliance and exposures to the Treasury Committee quarterly.

controls.title: Investment valuation and hedge accounting review
controls.description: Investments and derivatives are valued at each reporting date using independent price sources or counterparty valuations validated by Finance; IFRS 9 classification, fair value hierarchy level and hedge effectiveness documentation are reviewed by the Financial Controller, and valuation movements are reconciled to the ledger.

controls.title: Month-end FX rate maintenance and revaluation
controls.description: Period-end exchange rates are uploaded to the ERP rate table from the SAMA/central bank published rates by the Treasury Accountant and verified by a second person before the automated revaluation of monetary balances is run; the FX gain/loss report is reviewed by the Financial Controller for reasonableness against exposure and rate movements.

controls.title: Petty cash imprest and surprise counts
controls.description: Petty cash is operated on an imprest basis with a fixed float, disbursements supported by approved vouchers and receipts, and replenishment approved by the Finance Manager. Finance performs unannounced cash counts at least quarterly and reconciles the count to the imprest balance and ledger.

controls.title: Cash forecasting and liquidity review
controls.description: Treasury prepares a 13-week rolling cash forecast weekly, compares actual to forecast cash movements, and reports liquidity headroom against facility limits to the CFO; material variances are explained and forecast assumptions updated.

controls.title: Segregation of duties in treasury
controls.description: The users who prepare payment files, approve payments, record bank transactions and prepare bank reconciliations are different individuals, enforced through ERP roles and bank portal profiles; the segregation matrix is reviewed by the CFO quarterly.
